details: Linux (Manjaro, KDE Wayland) 1.0.64: inserting a channel, or moving a channel added at the end up, then writing leaves a blank slot above the inserted channel; the write froze partway and needed a force quit; the radio rebooted and recovered. CPS cleanup restored the radio.
summary: Write after inserting/moving a channel: blank channel left above it, write froze mid-upload
